title: Dungeons & Dragons Encounter Analysis with Semi-Random Simulation in Foundry VTT
abstract: arXiv:2610.38975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) is a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) in which a group of players, guided by a Game Master, roleplay a fantasy adventure with simulated combat and improvisational narrative. In D&D, an encounter is a single instance of simulated combat, where the players must use their characters to attempt to defeat a selection of enemy characters that the GM controls. D&D has multiple systems that approximate encounter difficulty by summing individual difficulty values that designers predefine for each enemy. However, since players and enemies can have a wide variety of capabilities, encounter difficulty depends on more than just the estimated difficulty of each monster. For example, these metrics do not account for positioning and dungeon layout, the synergies between monster abilities, and player party composition. We have created a tool, Mage-Hand, that can simulate D&D encounters semi-randomly using Foundry Virtual Tableto

translated_title: 龙与地下城遭遇战分析：基于Foundry VTT的半随机模拟
translated_abstract: 龙与地下城（D&D）是一款桌面角色扮演游戏（TTRPG），游戏中一群玩家在游戏主持人的引导下，通过模拟战斗和即兴叙事来扮演一场奇幻冒险。在D&D中，遭遇战是单次模拟战斗的实例，玩家必须使用自己的角色来尝试击败由游戏主持人控制的一组敌方角色。D&D拥有多种通过将设计者为每个敌人预先定义的单项难度值求和来估算遭遇战难度的系统。然而，由于玩家和敌人可能拥有各种各样的能力，遭遇战的难度并不仅仅取决于每个怪物的预估难度。例如，这些指标没有考虑到站位与地下城布局、怪物能力之间的协同效应，以及玩家队伍的构成等因素。我们开发了一个名为Mage-Hand的工具，它可以使用Foundry Virtual Tableto（虚拟桌面平台）对D&D遭遇战进行半随机模拟。
tldr: 本文开发了名为Mage-Hand的工具，利用Foundry VTT对龙与地下城遭遇战进行半随机模拟，以克服传统难度评估系统无法考虑地形布局、怪物能力协同和队伍构成等因素的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mage-Hand, a tool that semi-randomly simulates D&D encounters in Foundry VTT to overcome the limitations of traditional difficulty metrics that fail to account for dungeon layout, monster ability synergies, and party composition.
